intent: Count catalogue product variants whose product kind is 'Wood and Drywall Screw'.
success_criteria: Returns an integer count of product_variants rows joined to product_kinds where product_kind_name = 'Wood and Drywall Screw'
Answer is exactly the decimal count in '%d' form
refs cite the record_path of every matched product variant

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name ORDER BY pv.product_sku;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id WHERE pk.product_kind_name = :kind_name;
